en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 51.  Umme Saeed Hamsiya says that she was present near Imam  Ja’far  Sadiq  (a.s.)  when  her  maid  came  to  her  and said, “I have brought the mount.” Imam (a.s.) asked, “What is that mount for? Where are you going?” She replied, “I am going for Ziyarat of the graves of the  martyrs.”  Imam  (a.s.)  said,  “I  am  surprised  that  you people of Iraq travel long distances and perform Ziyarat of the  martyrs  but  don’t  go  for  the  Ziyarat  of  the  chief  of martyrs.  Why  don’t  you  go  for  his  Ziyarat?”  She  asked, “Who is the chief of martyrs?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “Imam Husain (a.s.).” She said, “But I am a woman.” Imam (a.s.) said, “Other  women like  you should also go for Ziyarat.”
She asked, “What is the reward of his Ziyarat?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “The reward of this Ziyarat is equal to that of a Hajj, Umrah, performing  Etekaf in Masjid-e-Haraam  and fasting for two months.”
